catalog.title: OptVec interpret
catalog.mac: Research methods: Author request, review inputs, then open execution and evidence. Both CLIs use science interview/draft/publish and the same managed engine.
outputs: Operation report and its provenance; inspect the declared run/config output.
catalog.restriction: Explicit config, reviewed input hashes and a fresh engine plan are required. GPU work requires immutable model revisions. Outputs are new records; local/Slurm execution uses the existing scientific owner. Native MLX numerical equivalence is not claimed. Remote training and analysis outputs are retained; the diagnostic cleanup policy does not authorize their removal.

fields.label: Model commit
fields.help: The exact version of the model. Inspect the selected model to fill its commit automatically; an agent can also supply a verified commit. This prevents silently switching model versions.

fields.label: Held-out probe prompts
fields.help: Held-out prompts for inspecting the trained vector’s behavior. Use one prompt per line, either plain text or a JSON object with a text field. These are not multiple-choice training rows. The example illustrates syntax only; choose prompts suitable for your study.
